name: legalithm
description: EU AI Act risk classification, obligations and Article 50 disclosures, cited to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. Runs offline, no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Classify EU AI Act risk, cite obligations, draft Article 50 disclosures. Offline, no API key.
interface.longDescription: Four MCP tools over stdio. classify, explain_obligation and generate_disclosure run fully offline with the rule engine bundled, so no source code, prompt or result leaves the machine and no API key is needed. check_record reads a published Trust Center record. Every answer carries an Article citation and an asOf date from a versioned corpus checked against Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744. A cited starting point, not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Does the EU AI Act apply to the AI feature in this repo, and what tier is it?
We are the provider of a customer-support chatbot for the EU. What obligations apply?
Draft the Article 50 transparency disclosure for our AI-generated content, in German.
